proposals.client_name: Bahon Management & Green Bashundhara Society Committee
proposals.project_title: Bahon Fleet Command Center: Real-Time Spatial Telemetry & Anti-Leakage Revenue Operating System
proposals.project_summary: Enterprise operating system and cloud command center for Bashundhara Residential Area's transition to an organized electric transit fleet. Features real-time vehicle telemetry across Blocks A–P, live battery depot inventory management, anti-leakage cashless QR/bKash fare reconciliation, and automated security gate intrusion geofencing.

scope_items.title: 1. Spatial Fleet Command Center & Bashundhara Block-to-Block Geofencing Engine
scope_items.description: Interactive high-density GIS map covering Blocks A through P. Configurable zone polygons, restricted zone monitoring, live congestion heatmaps, and sub-second vehicle positioning.

scope_items.title: 2. IoT Telemetry & Live Vehicle Fleet Ingress (Initial Fleet up to 50 Bahon EVs)
scope_items.description: Real-time telemetry ingestion pipelines capturing battery state of charge (SoC), operational velocity, GPS coordinates, passenger occupancy status, and automated maintenance alert triggers.

scope_items.title: 3. Cashless QR Fare Collection & Automated Daily Revenue Reconciliation
scope_items.description: Dynamic QR fare collection system integrated with bKash and cashless digital payment rails. Eliminates manual cash leakage with automated driver shift reconciliation and society revenue share audits.

scope_items.title: 4. Security Gate Intrusion Alert & Traditional Rickshaw Intercept Protocol
scope_items.description: Automated perimeter gate geofencing detecting unauthorized entry by non-registered traditional rickshaws. Dispatches instant visual alerts and security post notifications for rapid interception.

scope_items.title: 5. Solar Swap Depot Inventory & Battery Health Telemetry (Hubs Alpha & Beta)
scope_items.description: Dedicated battery inventory management console tracking real-time swap station bays, charging cycles, battery degradation diagnostics, and predictive replenishment alerts across primary depots.

one_time_items.name: Bahon Fleet Command Center 30-Day Managed Pilot Deployment
one_time_items.description: Full system architecture, spatial GIS geofencing map setup, IoT telemetry ingestion integration for up to 50 Bahon EVs, solar depot tracking, and cashless fare audit configuration.

recurring_items.name: Monthly Fleet Cloud Telemetry & Maintenance Retainer (Post-Pilot)
recurring_items.description: Dedicated high-availability cloud hosting, real-time telemetry streaming pipelines, continuous map updates, and priority under-60-minute defect support.

proposals.terms:
1. Commercial Investment: ৳60,000 BDT for the 30-Day Managed Pilot Deployment (up to 50 active Bahon electric vehicles).
2. Payment Milestones:
   • 50% Mobilization Advance (৳30,000 BDT) upon proposal acceptance to provision cloud telemetry servers and configure spatial geofencing.
   • 50% Final Settlement (৳30,000 BDT) upon pilot handover and Green Bashundhara Committee UAT sign-off.
3. Post-Pilot Cloud Retainer: ৳15,000 BDT/month (Optional) for ongoing high-availability cloud telemetry hosting, server maintenance, and SLA support.
4. Intellectual Property & Sovereignty: Green Bashundhara Initiative retains full data ownership and telemetry log privacy.
5. Virtual CTO & Architecture Lead: Zayan (GRO10X Holdings). Commercial Sponsor: Arif Ahmed (GRO-PARTNER-01 / Banglalink Enterprise).
